description: This file declares the GstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory class, which implements the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory interface. It provides a factory method to create instances of IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper, used within the Rialto server component for GStreamer protection metadata handling.

classes.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating GstProtectionMetadataWrapper instances, implementing IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory.

methods.name: createProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper, given a shared pointer to an IGstWrapper.
